title: 100 Vibrant Years: Epigenetic Rejuvenation & Preventative Healthspan
tagline: Transient epigenetic reprogramming, zombie-cell clearance, and multi-organ clocks compress late-life frailty so 85 feels biologically like 48.
cynicBelief: Longevity science is a vanity project for billionaires chasing immortality in glass towers—while ordinary families still watch their parents spend their final twelve years trapped in wheelchairs, memory-care wards, and bankrupting hospital beds.
breakthroughCounter: Aging is largely reversible epigenetic static rather than deleted DNA hardware. Between 2024 and late 2026, partial Yamanaka OSK reprogramming (Life Biosciences ER-100) restored lost optic-nerve vision in primates without erasing cell identity, targeted senolytics cleared inflammatory zombie cells, thymic regeneration rebuilt naive T-cells, and GLP-1 clinical trials measurably reversed multi-organ DNA methylation aging clocks.
socialNormShift: Retiring Bismarck's 1930s 'shelf-life at 65' cliff in favor of Okinawa- and Singapore-style multi-chapter lives—where universal sub-$400/year preventative rejuvenation rescues Medicare and national pensions from chronic-care insolvency.

quote.text: Aging is not a one-way street etched in stone; the youthful blueprint remains intact inside old cells, waiting for epigenetic resets to restore tissue health.

socialNormShift: Replacing handcuffs, 8-week waitlists, and willpower lectures with same-hour open-door neuro-sanctuaries and salaried Trieste-style craft cooperatives—eliminating the Day 29 loneliness relapse cliff.
